evidence.quote: James Dunphy Partner and Chief Finance Officer James joined Trinity Street in December 2014 and has been a qualified accountant since 2008. James was an auditor at Ernst & Young and has held various accounting roles at RBS, Piper Jaffray and CLSA before Trinity Street. He has a BA in Economics from Middlesex University.
